hero.name: Alberto Perez Gant
hero.subtitle: Software Engineer | Data & AI Specialist
hero.description: Industrial Engineer and Data Scientist with over 7 years of professional experience spanning industrial engineering and end-to-end data and AI projects—from data engineering and Python API/backend development to machine learning modeling and production deployment. Experienced in leading R&D initiatives and technical teams in the industrial sector, combining strategic perspective with hands-on delivery across full-stack development, cloud, and automation.

experience.title: AIMPLAS - Data Scientist, Digital Industry
responsibilities: Led the implementation of the organization’s data lakehouse architecture, creating a scalable foundation for analytics and AI workloads.
Designed and deployed end-to-end data pipelines for technical and experimental data ingestion, transformation, and modeling using Microsoft Fabric and PySpark.
Applied machine learning and NLP to technical documentation for information extraction and decision support in R&D projects.
Automated analytical workflows, managed R&D projects with industrial partners, and supported data governance.
Used Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), SQL, and unstructured data in collaboration with engineering and laboratory teams.

experience.title: UPV / Multidisciplinar Mathematics Institute - Machine Learning & Data Engineer (Applied R&D)
responsibilities: Designed and trained computer vision models for image detection and classification with TensorFlow and PyTorch, taking machine learning models from experimentation to practical use.
Analyzed data and queried SQL and JSON databases to produce insights for research and infrastructure projects.
Developed scientific and automation software in Python, Bash, and MATLAB, including reproducible reporting pipelines.
Contributed to hardware-focused R&D, including the design and integration of electronic systems, embedded components, and prototype manufacturing and validation.
Prepared technical documentation and project reports for stakeholders.
